column1: Purpose: See your inputs one day at a time, one row per date, pulled straight from your other tabs.
1. This is the same data as your other tabs, just laid out one row per day instead of one row per entry. You don't need to enter anything here, every column fills in on its own.
2. The first date is the only editable cell, change it if you want the sheet to start on a different day. Every row after that follows automatically.
3. Add or remove metric columns if you want to track something different, just copy the formula pattern from an existing column and swap in the tab name and column you want to count.
4. Use this view when you want to see everything you did on one specific day, or spot a pattern across days and weeks.
